item.title: Fifteen years of data link plastic pollution to seabird population losses
item.description: [Climate & Environment] Keyword: plastic pollution — Every year, about 50 million metric tons of plastic is dumped into the environment. After hatching on the island, these birds head out to sea for several years before returning to breed as adults.
